# Tirumala Automation

> Tirumala Automation builds Excel automation (Excel AI OS), Power Apps mobile apps, QR code generation and piece-by-piece scanning inventory systems for garment manufacturers, furniture makers and interior designers in India. Everything is built on Microsoft platforms: data is stored on Microsoft servers, encrypted end to end, with automated backups.

## Pages
- [Home](https://tirumala-automation.com/): what we build, workflow, FAQ
- [Industries](https://tirumala-automation.com/industries.html): garment manufacturing, furniture manufacturing, interior designers
- [Solutions](https://tirumala-automation.com/solutions.html): 17 Excel modules, QR generation and scanning, Power Apps, Microsoft security
- [Clients](https://tirumala-automation.com/clients.html): garment manufacturers using the system, including V-Fabrica, Dear To Dad, Gyro Kraft and HM Impo Expo Pvt Ltd
- [About](https://tirumala-automation.com/about.html): founders Mohit Agarwal and Rohit Agarwal
- [Contact](https://tirumala-automation.com/contact.html): book a live demo

## Key facts
- Services: Excel automation and VBA, Power Apps development, QR code inventory system, production tracking, costing, BOM, daily KPI reports, WhatsApp alerts
- Industries: garment manufacturing, furniture manufacturing, interior design
- Platform: Microsoft Excel, Power Apps, SharePoint
